settings.heading: How can I reach TruSea support?
settings.row_content: You can contact us via WhatsApp, call, or email. We usually reply within a couple of hours.

settings.heading: What details should I share for faster help?
settings.row_content: What details should I share for faster help?

settings.heading: I placed an order but didn’t get confirmation—what should I do?
settings.row_content: Check SMS/email/WhatsApp updates first. If you still don’t see it, message us with your phone number and time of order.

settings.heading: How do I reschedule my delivery?
settings.row_content: Message us as early as possible with your order ID. We’ll confirm the next available slot.

settings.heading: Can I change the cut style or quantity after placing an order?
settings.row_content: If the order is not processed yet, we can try to update it. Share your order ID and requested change.

settings.heading: My order arrived damaged / not packed properly—what next?
settings.row_content: Send us photos of the package and items within 30 minutes of delivery. We’ll help resolve it quickly.

settings.heading: I received the wrong item—how do I report it?
settings.row_content: Send the order ID + a photo of the received item. We’ll arrange the right resolution.

settings.heading: Refund timeline—how long does it take?
settings.row_content: Refunds are usually processed in 3–7 business days depending on your payment method.

settings.heading: Do you deliver to my area?
settings.row_content: Share your pin code/area name. We’ll confirm delivery availability and timelines.

settings.heading: Still have questions?
settings.row_content: If your question isn’t listed here, just message us—our team will help you.
